items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per coach; same knee as prior PCL/bone bruise last year—scary.
items.why: Coach Kubiak: working tail off, day-to-day, will play if ready; smart with trainers.
items.implication: Monitor practice; Michael Mayer benefits if out again. TE upside if returns healthy.

items.text: Ladd McConkey rib injury day-to-day per Harbaugh; monitored this week, status up in air vs Raiders. Left after big hit, did not return.
items.why: Harbaugh: day-to-day, see how feels; Rapoport confirms monitored/up in air.
items.implication: Prepare without; Quentin Johnston/Tre Harris rise if inactive. High priority monitor.

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring not considered serious; MRI but day-to-day, likely would have returned if playoff game. Left early after big performance.
items.why: Sources: not serious, would play through in playoffs; MRI pending.
items.implication: Monitor practice; Bateman/Lane (wrist longer-term) beneficiaries if out. Expect play W2 likely.

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT 4.9 (2.5 last night); only 2 targets (7% share) but routes strong (29 of 33 Mahomes dropbacks, 2nd behind Worthy 30).
items.why: Routes present but tiny aDOT and low target share limit box-score payoff without volume spike.
items.implication: Needs more targets to be viable WR; monitor volume trend.

items.text: Kenneth Walker was a true workhorse in KC debut: handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities, 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share), 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec.
items.why: Dominated early opportunities, high route/target share as expected true lead back.
items.implication: Elite RB1 usage locked in with Mahomes; strong ROS outlook.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty ascends to high-end RB1: 99 Utilization Score (tied Bijan), 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets, 23 att/6 tgt, 2 TDs, 156 scrimmage yds. Bullish ROS.
items.why: Dominated Vegas backfield; improved YBC/YAC; elite prospect + scheme fit.

items.text: Travis Etienne downgrades to low-end RB2: even w/ Kamara out, 58% snaps but only 43% attempts, 38% routes; 3-way committee. Antennae up.
items.why: Shared work heavily despite Kamara absence; high play volume inflated points.
items.implication: Cautious start; Kamara return hurts more. Check next week.

items.text: Bucky Irving 22.3 PPR overstated vs usage (8 carries, TD, 21 routes, 7/7 targets); sole RB carry inside 10, out-routed Gainwell 21-13, looked extremely healthy. Great CLE matchup next.
items.why: Goal-line work + route edge + health confirmation despite modest carries.
items.implication: Mid-RB2 floor with upside; Gainwell secondary.
items.opportunity: only GL carry, 21 routes vs 13, 7 targets

items.text: Surprised Travis Etienne didn't dominate more with Alvin Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53/26/15 Etienne/Miller/Donaldson; routes 24/5/7; opps 18/9/4.
items.why: Even without Kamara, shared work significantly; routes/opps not dominant.
items.implication: Low-end RB2; Kamara return further muddies. Miller handcuff interest.

items.text: Malik Nabers first game post-ACL/meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets team-high 31% share, 6-69-0; emerged healthy.
items.why: Immediate high route/target share on limited snaps post long layoff.
items.implication: WR1 upside locked if volume holds; ramp-up complete.

items.text: Bucky Irving upgrades to mid-range RB2: 85 Util Score, 62% snaps, 58% routes, led rushes, short-yardage edge, outpaced Gainwell. Positive step, historical 16.4 PPG avg.
items.why: Clear lead over Gainwell in snaps/routes/short yardage despite early deficit script.
items.implication: Startable RB2; Gainwell holds as RB4.

items.text: David Montgomery upgrades high-end RB2: 65% attempts (all inside-5), short-yardage lead vs Bills shootout; 79 Util historically ~15.4 PPG, low-mid RB1 comps.
items.why: Clear ground RB1 + GL work despite 50/50 camp talk; Marks two-minute only.
items.implication: Reliable RB2 with TD upside; Marks contingent.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love low-end RB short-term but borderline RB1 upside ROS: 44% snaps/37% att after high-ankle, slight route edge, 20% TPRR, scored; expect lead role eventually (elite prospect).
items.why: Active and productive split with Allgeier; rookie ramp normal, Super Model elite.
items.implication: Hold for lead role; flex now with upside.

items.text: Lions incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, ARSB, LaPorta, Jamo accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2/WR3/TE2 usage.
items.why: As expected for good offense; core four dominate all opps.
items.implication: Start all four confidently; ignore depth.
